notes.subject: 2026/future provider opportunity - Mukilteo Lighthouse Festival
notes.body: 2026 Mukilteo Lighthouse Festival is Sept. 11-13 at Lighthouse Park, 609 Front Street, Mukilteo WA. Official festival information says normal booth applications are closed and lists info@mukfest.com / 425-353-5516. Do not treat that as an automatic rejection for a separate staffed attraction area. Outreach should ask whether there is still any entertainment opportunity for 2026 and explain the prepaid model clearly: the event pays the package fee and guests can enjoy the attractions at no charge. If this year is fully set, ask to be considered for 2027/future events. Washington is weather-restricted, not on hold, so prepaid should be the primary model; pay-for-play can remain secondary if appropriate. No Adventure Zone Gmail history was found.

followUps.label: Mukilteo 2026/future follow-up
followUps.reason: Ask whether a separate entertainment opportunity still exists this year despite booth applications being closed. Lead with prepaid so guests play free; if 2026 is fully set, keep the relationship for 2027/future events.
